answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust by a bounded-length random walk, using endpoint mass as voting weight. For a Sybil set S, low conductance, φ(S)=w(S,S̄)/vol(S), means little flow crosses its boundary; with capped per-identity votes and a fixed horizon, its aggregate influence is bounded by boundary flow, not internal node count. A harbor of fake accounts cannot anchor power without external attestations; a raven-like bridge must raise the cut.
